statement: Unauthenticated POST /items with a JSON body returns 401 (not 2xx).
Authenticated POST /items with {"name":"demo"} and Bearer hello-demo-token returns 201 with string id and name equal to demo.
After an authenticated create, GET /items returns a list containing an item named demo (or GET /items/:id returns 200 with name demo).
In the Notes UI while signed out, submitting Create shows a visible error and does not add a new note row.
README documents Track A vs Track B (UI-visible) in ≤10 minutes; CI pins scripts/oracle.sh hash.
